title: Feller Property and Absorption of Diffusions for Multi-Species Metacommunities
summary: We consider individuals of two species distributed over m patches, each with a hosting capacity $d_i N$ , where $d_i \in (0, 1]$. We assume that all the patches are linked by the dispersal of individuals. This work examines how the metacommunity evolves in these patches. The model incorporates Wright-Fisher intra-patch reproduction and a general exchange function representing dispersal. Under minimal assumptions, we demonstrate that as $N$ approaches infinity, the processes converge to a diffusion process for which we establish the Feller property.
